page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The memory configuration consists of 128.0 GB of RAM, translating to 8.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates on the KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the weak and poor categories, with single-threaded gzip compression also scoring in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show average read and write speeds, though the overall PassMark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is classified as memory-optimized. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without demanding top-tier single-core compute speeds. Average performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving makes it suitable for relational databases, caching layers, and multi-threaded enterprise applications. It is less suitable for single-threaded processing or heavy computational tasks like large-scale LLM inference.
